name: Knowledge graph
short_description: A data model that represents entities and typed relationships explicitly so software can traverse connections, for example across production stages in a genealogy investigation.

evidence.quote: A knowledge graph makes those relationships explicit
A knowledge graph becomes worth considering when the questions demand it.
A knowledge graph puts those relationships into a connected information model.
A knowledge graph gives you one way to model them.
Digital twins and knowledge graphs add relationships.
That's where a knowledge graph becomes practical, from PPR to an industrial knowledge graph.
